## PRB1.7. Investments {#prb1.7.-investments .Heading-2-ER}

- EANS planned a total asset value for new investments in RP4 of 31.8M€2022, of which 55.2% relates to new major investments. EANS planned 1 new major investment for RP4, which has started.

- In 2025, EANS overspent +0.3M€2022 (+321.4%) in costs related to new major investments. This is mainly due to the updated payment schedule and earlier cost recognition.

- According to the reporting tables, EANS overspent +0.6M€2022 (+15.7%) in costs related to investments in 2025.

- EANS reported 0.4M€2022 in funding from Union assistance programmes in 2025.
